motions.item_title: Approve the appointment of Marcia Vasquez for Library Board Advisor for a Three -year Term begi…
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to approve the appointment of Marcia Vasquez for Library Board Advisor for a Three -year Term beginning January 2026 through December 31, 202 8. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Appoint Marcia Vasquez to the library board
motions.summary: The council took up the appointment of Marcia Vasquez as a library board advisor for a three-year term through December 31, 2028.
motions.impact: This is routine housekeeping — nothing changes for residents, and the minutes do not record how the vote came out.

motions.item_title: Approve the appointment of Mandy Lane for Planning Commissioner for a One-year Term beginning J…
motions.motion: Councilmember Huish moved to approve the appointment of Mandy Lane for Planning Commissioner for a One-year Term beginning January 2026 through December 31, 202 6. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Appoint Mandy Lane to the planning commission
motions.summary: The council appointed Mandy Lane as a planning commissioner for a one-year term running from January 2026 through December 31, 2026.
motions.impact: Lane will help review zoning changes and development proposals before they reach the council this year. Nothing changes for you day to day.

motions.item_title: Approve the appointment of Chad Decoursey for Planning Commission Alternate for a Three -year T…
motions.motion: Councilmember Huish moved to approve the appointment of Chad Decoursey for Planning Commission Alternate for a Three -year Term beginning January 2026 through December 31, 202 8. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Appoint Chad Decoursey as planning commission alternate
motions.summary: The council appointed Chad Decoursey as an alternate on the planning commission for a three-year term running through December 31, 2028.
motions.impact: Alternates step in when a regular commissioner is absent, so Decoursey may end up weighing in on zoning and development applications. Nothing changes for you day to day.

motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to approve the Consent Agenda. Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Approve the routine consent agenda
motions.summary: The council approved its consent agenda, the batch of routine items passed together in one vote; the minutes do not list the individual items here.
motions.impact: This is routine housekeeping — nothing here changes for residents on its own.

motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Appointing Lacie Messerly as the Eagle Mountain City Recorder . Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Appoint Lacie Messerly as city recorder
motions.summary: The council appointed Lacie Messerly as Eagle Mountain's city recorder, the official responsible for the city's records and meeting minutes.
motions.impact: This is routine housekeeping — nothing changes for residents day to day.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 2.45 regarding Youth Council.
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 2.45 regarding Youth Council with updated revisions made in Work Session. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Update the rules for the city's Youth Council
motions.summary: The council rewrote the section of city code that governs the Youth Council, adopting revisions worked out earlier the same evening.
motions.impact: This touches teens who serve on the Youth Council and the staff who run it. The motion does not spell out what changed, and nothing changes for other residents.

motions.item_title: A pprove the Minor Site Plan for the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange with the following conditio…
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to a pprove the Minor Site Plan for the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange with the following conditions: • The Dynamic Fitness and Strength equipment bid dated January 13, 2026 , be completed as proposed ; and • The Hidden H ollow Wellness Center and Outdoor G athering Amenity Area be completed as presented in the packet; and • The clubhouse contains at least one am enity as required by City Code ; and • The item will be brought back to the City Council for approval through a n Agreement . Councilmember Huish seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Approve Hidden Hollow gym and gathering area swap
motions.summary: The city approved the site plan for the Hidden Hollow amenity exchange, requiring the proposed fitness equipment, wellness center, and outdoor gathering area be built as presented.
motions.impact: If you live in Hidden Hollow, the developer must deliver the gym equipment, wellness center, and outdoor gathering area shown to the council, plus at least one clubhouse amenity. A final agreement still has to come back for approval.

motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved that a code requirement for any amenity exchange requests be made early in the process be added to the Legislative Priorities List . Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Put amenity-swap timing rule on the city's to-do list
motions.summary: The council added a proposed code change to its legislative priorities list, requiring that requests to swap a promised amenity be made early in the process.
motions.impact: Nothing changes yet — this only puts the idea on the city's list of code updates to write later. If it becomes code, it would fall on developers, not residents.
